title: Meadow Wood House – Entire Home
house_rules: Self check-in from 3:00 pm. Please tell us your arrival time in advance.
Check-out is by 11:00 am.
No smoking inside. Smoking is allowed only outside.
No parties or events.
Quiet hours are 10:00 pm to 8:00 am.
Guests under 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.
description:
Spacious 5-bedroom private home in the heart of Indiana, PA, just 3 minutes from Downtown Indiana. The house has a large front and back yard with a back porch and a barbecue grill, a private patio and an oversized driveway that fits up to 4 vehicles. Inside you'll find generous living space, five comfortable bedrooms (four queen beds and one king bed), two full bathrooms (one upstairs, one in the basement) and a full kitchen. It's perfect for families, travel professionals and groups. Whether you're visiting for work, school or a weekend getaway, this home offers privacy, convenience and comfort.

Great for: families visiting IUP, travel nurses and medical professionals, corporate housing, group stays, long-term guests and weekend visitors. Ideal if you want a full private home with yard space and easy parking.

What's yours: the entire 5-bedroom house, the large backyard, the front yard patio, the full kitchen, the laundry room in the basement, the back porch with a barbecue grill, the garage and the private driveway (room for 4 cars). There are no shared spaces; the whole home is yours.

Check-in is self check-in, for flexibility and privacy. We're always available by message if you need help, local recommendations or support during your stay.

The neighborhood: a quiet residential street in the heart of Indiana, PA. The area is peaceful and safe, and close to downtown shops, restaurants, hospitals and the IUP campus.

Getting around: 3 minutes to Downtown Indiana, 5 minutes to IRMC Hospital (Indiana Regional Medical Center) and 5 minutes to IUP. Large private driveway and easy access to main roads, perfect for guests traveling with several vehicles or larger groups.

description: A private queen bedroom (upstairs) in a spacious house on a quiet residential street in Indiana, PA: 3 minutes to Downtown Indiana and 5 minutes to IUP and IRMC Hospital. You share the upstairs bathroom with the other two upstairs rooms, plus the full kitchen, living room and laundry room (in the basement). Relax on the back porch with the barbecue grill or in the big backyard. Free parking in the private driveway, Wi-Fi, air conditioning and self check-in. Great for students' families, travel nurses, medical professionals and long-term guests.
